name: Light sleeper
text: Needs 2 h more sleep in a noisy base, but wakes the others at the first scrape at the door (+6 base defense).

name: Heat-acclimatised
text: Years of work in the sun: needs less extra water in the heat and heats up more slowly.

name: Smoker
text: Smokes a pack a day. Without cigarettes, stress climbs fast. Cigarettes turn up in grocery stores and houses.

name: Handles gore
text: Has seen worse. Half the stress from deaths and wounds.

name: Strong back
text: Carries 30% more on scavenging trips and moves.

name: Squeamish
text: Goes pale at blood: treats wounds as if 3 points less skilled, and their own wounds weigh heavier.

name: Night owl
text: Works 20% better on the night shift and 10% worse by day.

name: Steady nerves
text: Fights and attacks rattle them less (stress from fighting x0.6).

name: Knows the town
text: Knows the back lanes and where people kept things: travels 15% faster and finds a little more.

name: Frugal cook
text: Cooks faster on less: 40% less gas or firewood, 30% more food prepared per hour.

name: Knows medicines
text: Finds 50% more medicine on a search, and with them at base antibiotics save more septic patients.

name: Driver
text: Can drive a found vehicle. Without a driver in the group, a vehicle is just scrap.
